subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) During the time when he was the president of America, a civil war took place over the question of slavery. (b) He rose from a humble origin. (c) As a man, he was simple and kind. (d) Lincoln was born in 1809. (e) It began in 1861 and continued for more than four years and Lincoln was in favour of the slaves. (f) Abraham Lincoln was among the greatest Presidents of the United States of America. (g) There were many Negro slaves in America in those days. (h) Lincoln became great by dint of his own efforts and perseverance.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
